**Platform**

**Does it have a public API, or a public feed (RSS/Atom)?**

Link to the API docs, or the feed URL pattern. If neither exists, this has to be a
`manual` or `url-only` connector rather than an `api` one — see
[docs/adding-a-connector.md](../../docs/adding-a-connector.md#before-you-write-anything)
for what that means and why it is not a workaround.

**What would it import?** (projects, publications, posts, stats, …)

**Are you willing to build it?**

If so, [docs/adding-a-connector.md](../../docs/adding-a-connector.md) is the whole
walkthrough — most connectors are around eighty lines.
